)
Sync/Async
Synchronous

Non Reentrant

events
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType

E_NOT_OK: failed
Description
The callback notifies the customers, when a <TimeBase> related event occurs, which is
enabled by the notification mask

StbM_Externals.h

RS_TS_00016,

[SWS_StbM_00299] ⌈The status notification callback function shall be set by the pa-
rameter StbMTimeNotificationCallback.⌋(RS_TS_00016)
Note: The event notification callback might be called in interrupt context only, if there
is no callback configured in StbM which belongs to a SW-C.
